text: 🚨🎙️| Frenkie de Jong: “We haven’t been as consistent as usual, but we won’t abandon our identity. We can feel the fan's SUPPORT, and it gives us even more strength.” #fcblive

🚨 The last time Barcelona lost to Real Madrid on October 25, they went on to win the TREBLE that season!

It happened in the 2014/15 season, when Barça had also suffered a defeat against PSG beforehand. #fcblive 🏆
🚨🎙️| Frenkie de Jong: “Competition is healthy. This is Barcelona, so it’s nothing new. It’s good to have quality players competing for places in midfield.”  #fcblive
🚨🎙️| José Mourinho: “The VAR was sleeping in the 60th minute. Cancelo clearly deserved a red card for his challenge on Diomandé, and it would have changed the match.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “I’m disappointed. We had the chance to take the lead, but we have to accept the result and focus on what we can IMPROVE.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “It’s been a difficult week. We lost in Paris and have now suffered another defeat in La Liga. We’re still top of the table, but we need to bring more energy.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “We’re RUNNING OUT of defenders. I’m glad to have Frenkie and the others back, but managing the situation isn’t easy.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| João Cancelo: “I think we were the better team overall, at least in my opinion. But this is Real Madrid, they can create a few chances and score. We must REACT against Alavés next week. We’ll analyse our mistakes, correct them and try to make up for this defeat.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| João Cancelo: I think what we missed is, we often try to press high on the opponent, whereas there are moments when it’s better to control game through the possession. #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Defeats are part of football. We must analyse what happened and learn from it to improve.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “This defeat doesn’t make me DOUBT anything. These things happen, and in big games, the smallest details can make all the difference.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “I don’t accept excuses. We weren’t fresh today, but that’s something we have to deal with. The travel and international fixtures are part of the game. Now, we must focus on the matches ahead.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: "We may need to bring up players from the reserves and La Masia. I hope Andreas can return in the next few weeks.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: "We wanted to play in the final minutes with Raphinha as a 10, but he asked us to take him off. He had to come off. He could not play any longer." #fcblive
